items.title: Plex tells users to reset passwords after new data breach
items.description: Media streaming platform Plex is warning customers to reset passwords after suffering a data breach in which a hacker was able to steal customer authentication data from one of its databases. [...]

items.title: 45 Previously Unreported Domains Expose Longstanding Salt Typhoon Cyber Espionage
items.description: Threat hunters have discovered a set of previously unreported domains, some going back to May 2020, that are associated with China-linked threat actors Salt Typhoon and UNC4841.
